The room props do not float, morph or move; hands, forearms, eyes and heads perform the action. Row1 TEACHER: the navy-haired woman in magenta cardigan and navy skirt from reference holding an open teal book beside a green chalkboard; she points at the board, opens her palm towards student, settles back, with a small blink. Preserve arms/hands/joints and every face; no cropped heads, hands, feet, vehicles or props. Render only the32 cells, no poster headings.
